about.label: OUR STORY
about.title: Built from the ground up in Addis.
about.description1: Kassahun Wood and Aluminum Work was founded with a singular vision: to bridge the gap between artisanal woodworking and modern aluminum fabrication. What began as a small workshop has grown into a full-service interior craftsmanship studio, serving homes and businesses across Ethiopia.
about.description2: Our team of skilled carpenters, metal fabricators, and interior designers work collaboratively to transform spaces — from custom furniture pieces to complete office fit-outs. We believe that great design lives at the intersection of warmth and precision.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Timeline depends on scope. A single furniture piece may take 2-4 weeks, while a full office fit-out can take 6-12 weeks. We provide detailed timelines during the consultation phase.

items.question: Do you work outside Addis Ababa?
items.answer: Yes, we serve clients across Ethiopia. Travel and logistics costs are discussed during the project planning stage.

items.question: Can I choose my own materials?
items.answer: Absolutely. We encourage clients to visit our material library and select finishes. Our consultants can also recommend materials based on your budget and lifestyle.

items.question: Do you offer warranty on your work?
items.answer: All our work comes with a workmanship guarantee. Furniture has a 2-year warranty; aluminum installations carry a 5-year structural warranty.
